textes.Bienvenue chez Cap Ailleurs, une agence: Welcome to Cap Ailleurs, an agency for guided tours on five continents. textes.Procède en deux temps : calcule d’abord: Work in two steps: first calculate each tour’s total travelers, then the average of these totals per destination. Finally, compare each tour with its own destination’s average.
textes.Comment se classent les guides par nombr: How do the guides rank by number of tours?
textes.Cap Ailleurs est une agence de voyages q: Cap Ailleurs is a travel agency that sells guided tours: a guide leads each group. Each of the ten guides has been assigned to one or more tours, except the new ones, who don’t have any assignment yet. Before the annual reviews, Florent, who assigns the guides to the tours, ranks all the guides, new ones included, by the number of different tours they’ve led.
textes.son nombre de circuits différents, 0 s’i: their number of different tours, 0 if they have no assignment
textes.son rang : 1 pour le plus grand nombre d: their rank: 1 for the largest number of tours, ties share the same rank and the next rank skips (1, 1, 3)
textes.tous les guides, y compris ceux qui n’on: every guide, including those with no assignment
textes.Pars de tous les guides, même ceux sans: Start from every guide, even those without an assignment, and count their different tours: a new one gets 0. Then give them a place based on that number, with ties sharing their rank.
textes.Quels clients ont réservé plus de 2 fois: Which customers have booked the same tour more than 2 times?
textes.Cap Ailleurs est une agence de voyages q: Cap Ailleurs is a travel agency that sells guided tours. Some customers come back to the same tour, season after season. Bérénice, the director, wants to give a travel journal about their tour to the customers who have booked it more than 2 times, even if one of these bookings was cancelled or is still pending.
textes.le prénom du client (une ligne par clien: the customer’s first name (one row per customer and per tour)
textes.le nombre de réservations de ce circuit: the number of bookings of this tour by this customer
textes.seulement les clients qui ont réservé le: only the customers who have booked the same tour more than 2 times, so at least 3
textes.par nombre de réservations, du plus gran: by number of bookings, largest first, then by customer last name, then by first name, then by tour name
textes.Forme un groupe pour chaque couple clien: Make one group for each customer and tour pair, then count its bookings. The condition applies to that number: it applies once the counting is done.
textes.Quels clients ont payé plus que la moyen: Which customers have paid more than the average for their city?
textes.Cap Ailleurs est une agence de voyages q: Cap Ailleurs is a travel agency that sells guided tours. Its customers live in large European cities, from Paris to Vienna. What a customer has paid the agency is the sum of their payments marked “Paid”. Maëlle, who handles loyalty, is organizing customer evenings city by city. She wants to spot the customers who have paid more than their city’s average, calculated over the customers with at least one received payment.
textes.la moyenne des totaux payés des clients: the average of the totals paid by the customers from their city, rounded to two decimal places
textes.les clients dont le total payé dépasse s: the customers whose total paid is strictly above their city’s average
textes.par ville, puis par total payé, du plus: by city, then by total paid, highest first
textes.La moyenne d’une ville ne compte que ses: A city’s average only counts its customers with at least one payment with the status “Paid”.
textes.Procède en deux temps : calcule d’abord: Work in two steps: first calculate each customer’s total received, then the average of these totals per city. Finally, compare each customer with their own city’s average.

textes.par panier moyen, du plus élevé au plus: by average basket, highest first, then by last name, then by first name
